usage.source_scope: Twenty public building identities split without overlap into 10 train, four Development, and six PB1-unseen confirmation entities; 27 references and 48 current-view queries. Test portal pixels were previously used only for the separate proposer confirmation.
usage.project_application: Bind a separately requested public entity to the retained dual-family functional portal proposals before active belief, tracking, or guidance.
usage.modifications: Train only a small shared 32-to-16 candidate MLP and a mean/max/min set-summary NONE head over frozen structural, CLIP, DINOv2, facade-context, and support-ray features.
usage.expected_effect: Improve target portal ranking or halve wrong portal commits without losing Top-3, while preserving non-degenerate correct COMMIT/SET_VALUED coverage and rejecting wrong buildings.

evaluation.setup: Fixed building-disjoint PB1 Development/training/confirmation. Development selected the native support ray baseline. Test entities did not affect feature normalization, checkpoint selection, or baseline selection. A post-result adjudication corrected an all-NONE loophole without changing outputs or denominators.
evaluation.effect: The learned head kept Top-1 at 4/6, improved latent Top-3 from 5/6 to 6/6, and reduced wrong-building confirmations from 27/30 to 0/30. It nevertheless emitted NONE on all 36 test target/query episodes, reducing correct COMMIT/SET_VALUED truth coverage from 4/6 to 0/6. The route is therefore rejected rather than promoted by abstention collapse.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This rejects the frozen PB1 embedding/fusion head on the consumed public-image cohort. It does not reject a changed target-identity source/representation and establishes no access, traversability, active motion, tracking, guidance, arrival, product, user-benefit, or safety result.

evidence.summary: Frozen sources, split contract, model components, features, baselines, metrics, and original promotion expression.
Durable metrics, evaluator-integrity correction, terminal decision, evidence hashes, and claim boundary.
Raw deterministic training, baseline, test, backend, and per-episode output.
Post-result all-NONE integrity adjudication; no outputs, labels, or denominators changed.

history.change: Ran PB1 once on the frozen building-disjoint cohort. Rejected the learned head after universal NONE collapse; closed weight, threshold, embedding, backbone, and fusion tuning on this cohort. L10-AV0 remains blocked.
